label: Lid-converts-to-header tray
one_line: Ships closed and filled; tear the walls, swing the lid up, and the lid is the sign.
for: Stock that ships pre-filled and sets up in a minute.

locks.what: the liner's tab through the lid; each stair foot through the floor
the back-brace, into the lid and the back wall

allowances.panel_ends: half a caliper + fit gap short of the surface met
allowances.corner_folds: one caliper + fit gap, so a flap lies on the panel's inner face

reinforcement: a brace closing the triangle behind it
glue: small zones on the four corner flaps, marked
failures: a hinge with no lock flops
codes: No opened source shows a lid that itself becomes the header: this is our own construction from US6942102 (tear only on the lid), US6109514 (lid over the header), US8328079 (tear-out header).
provisional: Tear pattern: our own numbers; corrugated tear patterns were not found.
The brace is what holds the lid up: a sample proves the hinge.
